title: Shinonome Ena — This Claw's Too Weak!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Here's to a great game of strike zone!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kanade, Minori & Ichika
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad that we each could get a bottle of juice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! And it's all thanks to you for getting that bingo, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm still a bit surprised by how your first pitch didn't even make it to the panels.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But your last pitch ended up going really straight because your form was so good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just got lucky.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
There's nothing wrong with that.
The fact is, you hit the last panel we needed on your very last chance.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose you're right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, we're finished with our final activity, so let's start getting ready to head home.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Also, I'm pretty sweaty, so I'd like to take this opportunity to wipe myself down before I get too cold.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm gonna fix my makeup.
Also, my hair's probably a mess right now because of all this sweat.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, there's a makeup area over there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Seriously? That's perfect!
Let's go, now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, it was right next to the basketball courts this entire time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Interesting. I didn't notice either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, we're gonna go fix our makeup.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay!
In the meantime, I'll be wiping myself down.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too. I really don't want to catch a cold.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, we'll meet up once we're done!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. See you in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, they even have tissues.
And I can just use their mirror.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was worried that carrying around my makeup pouch would be a pain, but I'm glad I brought it along.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Geez, talk about a mess...
My hair's a total wreck!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't believe I looked like this while talking with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But we came here to work up a sweat and it was pretty hot out, so I guess this is expected. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry! It's just...
Your makeup seems totally fine even after working up such a good sweat, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not very good at doing my own makeup, so I have trouble getting it to hold...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see.
I'm not exactly what you call an expert either... Also, I went with something pretty light today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You did?!
Then, is my technique just that bad...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi's been teaching me a lot of things and I've been trying to put them into practice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you need time to get used to doing it, right? I could also try teaching you a few tricks I know...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Ena.
That was really helpful!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, Minori, you're an idol, so you'll want to figure out what sort of makeup is best for you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it might be best to ask Airi and the others about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi occasionally talks about this friend from junior high who knew a lot about fashion trends and stuff. Is that person you, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I knew it!
That's incredible. Where do you get all your information?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mostly from social media and video sites. I follow a lot of stylists and makeup artists.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I see...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's really impressive, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-It is? I don't think I'm doing anything special, but I suppose it's easy for me to gather this sort of info since I have such a keen interest in it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nothing special?
But I think it's really cool that you have a keen eye for detail!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wow, her eyes are sparkling.
Is what I do really that cool or special?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I remember Airi saying how Minori's a great student.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That time, all I thought was how good Airi is at looking after others...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But the way she asked me to teach her while looking straight at me... I feel like I should do everything I can to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hm? It's from Ichika...
Oh no! They're already at our meetup spot!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They are?! We've gotta get a move on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, Ena...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can we talk more later about makeup, clothes and other stuff later?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, I'd love to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! I can't wait!
